sourceEvidence.title: Quality Manager
sourceEvidence.quote:
· Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Industrial Technology, or a related technical discipline preferred.
· Equivalent combination of education and extensive industry experience may be considered.
**Experience :**
* US Citizen (required).
* Minimum 10 years of progressive Quality Management experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing QA and QC functions.
* Extensive experience in AS9100-regulated aerospace, defense, military, electronics, cable assembly, wire harness, or electromechanical manufacturing environments.
* Demonstrated experience with:
* First Article Inspection (AS9102)
* Root Cause Analysis
